snippet.title: Talespinner - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Enter a world steeped in Japanese mythology with Talespinner, a deck-building roguelike adventure where you become the storyteller. Choose one of three unique heroes, build your deck from over 200 cards, and shape your own narrative as you explore haunted bamboo forests, icy mountain caves, haunted villages and more. Face mythical yokai, forge unexpected alliances and dive into branching scenarios full of twists and replayability. Wishlist the game now on Steam and prepare to write your own legend.
